description: Class representing a list of values of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

Add.description: Adds a new value to the combo box / drop-down list content control.

params.description: The display text for the list item.
params.name: sText

params.description: The list item value. By default is equal to sText parameter
params.name: sValue

params.description: A position where a new value will be added. If nIndex=-1 add to the end.
params.name: nIndex

Add.signature: Add(sText: string, sValue: string, nIndex?: number): boolean

Clear.description: Clears a list of values of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetAllItems.description: Returns a collection of items (the ApiContentControlListEntry objects) of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiContentControlList class.

GetElementsCount.description: Returns a number of items of the combo box / drop-down list content control.

GetItem.description: Returns an item of the combo box / drop-down list content control by the position specified in the request.

GetParent.description: Returns a parent of the combo box / drop-down list content control.
